violation_type.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §747.303(a)(6))
violation_type.short_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not report allegations of an incident that put a child at risk to Child Care Regulation.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not report allegations of an incident that put a child at risk to Child Care Regulation.

A child in care walked away from the operation unsupervised and was located by Law Enforcement more than two miles from the operation. Permit holder was aware of this incident on the day it happened and did not notify Child Care Regulation as soon as possible or within two days.
During the investigation, it was found that a situation that placed a child at risk was not reported to Child Care Regulation within the required timeframe.
The director/primary caregiver failed to report to Child Care Regulation an incident involving a child exiting the facility without being supervised and being returned by a neighbor.
